changelog:
Initial release of praesidia-a2 for agent verification, trust scoring, discovery, and guardrails.

- Verify AI agents and check trust scores (0-100) for security and compliance.
- Discover marketplace agents matching specified tasks or capabilities.
- Fetch A2A (agent-to-agent) standard protocol cards and agent identity details.
- List, apply, and check guardrails for content moderation and policy enforcement.
- Access and use guardrail templates for security, compliance, content, and brand safety.
- Validate specific content against configured guardrails to assess policy compliance.
summary: Verify AI agents, check trust scores (0-100), fetch A2A agent cards, discover marketplace agents, apply guardrails for security and compliance. Use when user mentions agent verification, trust scores, agent discovery, A2A protocol, agent identity, agent marketplace, guardrails, security policies, content moderation, or asks "is this agent safe?" or "find agents that can [task]" or "apply guardrails to protect my agent".
